### Security & Verification Checklist
- [ ] Unique ID checked and verified (`python tools/community_tool.py check-id <id>`).
- [ ] Catalog passed local validation (`python scripts/validate_catalog.py`).
- [ ] Release archive uses HTTPS and contains valid `addon.json`.
- [ ] Confirmed zero compiled native executables (`.exe`, `.dll`, `.bat`, `.ps1`) in archive.
- [ ] Name and description are accurate and free of deceptive / inappropriate language.
